metrics.name: Domain List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Domains[].{domain: domain, status: status, expires: expires, autoRenew: renewAuto, renewable: renewable, renewDeadline: renewDeadline, privacy: privacy, locked: locked, nameServers: nameServers}
metrics.gotcha: renewAuto, locked, privacy, renewable are BOOLEAN. renewDeadline may be null (field exists on all domains but is null until the domain is close to expiry cutoff). nameServers is an array of strings.

metrics.name: Domains With Auto-Renew Disabled
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Domains[?renewAuto == `false`].{domain: domain, expires: expires, status: status}
metrics.okWhen: result is empty array (all domains have auto-renew enabled)
metrics.gotcha: renewAuto is BOOLEAN — use backtick-quoted `false`, not string 'false'.

metrics.name: Domains With Transfer Lock Disabled
metrics.okWhen: result is empty array (all active domains have transfer lock enabled)
metrics.gotcha: locked is BOOLEAN — use backtick-quoted `false`. A domain with status='CANCELLED' may still appear here.

metrics.name: Order List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Orders[].{orderId: orderId, createdAt: createdAt, currency: currency, totalPrice: pricing.total}
metrics.gotcha: pricing.total is an INTEGER in millicents (e.g., 44380000 = $44.38). Do NOT use pricing.total.amount — pricing.total is already the scalar. currency is a top-level field on the Order object (not under pricing). Orders do not have a type field.

metrics.name: Subscription List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Subscriptions[].{label: label, productGroupKey: product.productGroupKey, status: status, expiresAt: expiresAt, renewalPeriod: product.renewalPeriod, renewalPeriodUnit: product.renewalPeriodUnit, renewAuto: renewAuto}
metrics.gotcha: productGroupKey, renewalPeriod, and renewalPeriodUnit are NESTED under product.* — NOT top-level fields on the Subscription object. Prior path used top-level productGroupKey (returns null). Price/currency are not accessible at subscription level — use Orders[] for billing data.
